dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So what are you gonna eat while you're in Liyue?

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: Well, luckily my sister and I both know enough about cooking that we won't go hungry...

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: ...No, we can't let it come to that! We came on this trip to eat food from all around the world, and that's exactly what we're gonna do!

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: Yes, I must force myself to get used to the food here... Okay, full disclosure, we caved and cooked some pancakes this morning. Here, take them off me.

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: Come on, Geri, you can do this... One whole portion of chop suey, delicious chop suey...

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: Hello. As a native of Mondstadt, I must say that Liyue Harbor is quite a nice place, but as for the food...

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: My name is Geri. My sister Freki and I are "bon vivant" travelers in search of fine cuisine. Our aim is to taste and see all that the seven nations have to offer.

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: But we never expected to meet such an unprecedented challenge on our very first stop of the trip...

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: The people of Liyue are so unpleasant.

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: I absolutely cannot stand Zhongyuan Chop Suey, it's practically inedible!

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: Back in Mondstadt, my favorite food is Moon Pie.

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: It's a pie made with seasonal fruits, pieces of cheese, and chicken. When enjoyed together with a special fruit cocktail, it is most superb.

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: I hardly suspected that the neighboring Liyue cuisine would differ so greatly from our own. Never in my wildest dreams would I have imagined people that would make food from animal innards.

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: I still need some time to mentally prepare myself, whew...

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: May the God of Anemo bless you.

dialogues.speaker: Geri
dialogues.text: Alas, shall the very first stop already hail the end of our journey across the seven nations?
